= profile-edges(1)
:doctype: manpage
:name: Early
:blank:
:bold: pass:q[*Éva*]
:italic: pass:q[_Italic_]
:empty: pass:q[]
:missing: pass:a,q[*{missing}*]
:escaped: pass:a,q[*\{name}*]
:frozen: pass:a,q[*{name}*]
:alias: prefix {bold} / {italic} suffix
:second: before {alias} after
:explicit-alias: pass:a[https://example.org[Protected] before {bold} / {italic} after]
:escaped-alias: \{bold}
:raw: pass:[*Literal*]
:raw-alias: {raw} / {bold}
:raw-link: pass:[https://example.org[Literal]]
:mixed-link: {raw-link} / {bold}
:mixed-again: {mixed-link} / {mixed-link}
:link: pass:m[https://example.org[Site]]
:unused: pass:m[footnote:[Unused note.] anchor:unused[] ((Unused))]
:note: pass:m[footnote:[Anonymous note.]]
:named: pass:m[footnote:n[Named note.]]
:bad: pass:q,c[*Escaped*]
:bad-alias: pass:a,c[{bold}]
:unknown: pass:typo[*Unknown*]

== NAME

profile-edges - retained attribute profile edge cases

== DESCRIPTION

:name: Late

{second} / {raw-alias} / {explicit-alias} / {escaped-alias} / {mixed-again}.

{empty} / {missing} / {escaped} / {frozen}.

{link} / {note} / {note} / {named} / {named} / footnote:n[].

{bad} / {bad-alias} / {unknown}.
